text:
arik: Heads-up — planning to enable SBOM generation + cosign signing for all base images in GCR next week. Need to coordinate KMS-backed key rotation and a small RBAC change for the image-signing role.

mira: +1. Do we have a list of affected repos and which pipelines will need to add signing steps?

arik: Initial list is the usual base-image repos: infra/base-ubuntu, infra/base-alpine, runtime/minimal-rootless. CI pipelines: builders, release-stable, and nightly-minify. I'll paste the inventory to the infra doc after this.

samir: For KMS, are we using project-level CMEK or a dedicated key per environment? Strong preference for env-scoped keys so we can rotate independently.

arik: Proposal: one KMS key per environment (prod/stage/dev). Service accounts for signing will have kms.cryptoSign permission only on their env key.

elena: That matches compliance ask. We also need audit logs forwarded to our SIEM for every cosign verify event and key usage. Can the signing step emit structured audit events?

devops-bot: build infra/base-ubuntu:build-2026-03-15 succeeded 
  artifacts: gcr.io/redwood-inference/infra/base-ubuntu:2026-03-15
  sbom: sbom/infra-base-ubuntu-2026-03-15.spdx.json
  cosign_sig: cosign/infra-base-ubuntu-2026-03-15.sig

mira: For audit forwarding: we can add a small lambda on key usage pubsub -> fluentd -> SIEM. But would prefer not to create more long-lived functions. Maybe use pubsub subscription + log sink to BigQuery and export. Thoughts?

samir: Pubsub -> log sink is fine. Also need to ensure KMS Access is gated by RBAC: only the signing SA and the recovery SA can decrypt/verify; ops-oncall has read-only audit access.

arik: RBAC change I propose: create role imageSigner with kms.cryptoSign on env keys + iam.serviceAccounts.actAs on dedicated signing SA. Add to approvers group. Roll out via Terraform in a canary to dev, then stage, then prod.

elena: One more compliance req: we must generate SLSA provenance attestation along with the SBOM and signature. Can cosign handle attestations to KMS-backed keys?

samir: Yes, cosign supports KMS-backed key signing for attestations. We'll attach a predicate that includes build ID, git sha, builder image, and SBOM hash. Example predicate snippet: 
```
{
  "builder": "gnarly-ci/runner-3",
  "buildType": "https://redwood-inference.com/provenance/v1",
  "invocation": {"configSource": {"uri": "git+https://github.com/redwood/infra@refs/tags/v1.2.3"}},
  "materials": ["sha256:...sbom-hash..."]
}
```

arik: Good. Also — one off: there's a noisy vuln alert for CVE-2026-1148 in one minimal runtime layer surfaced by our image scanner this morning. We should triage before the signing flips or we'll sign vulnerable images.

mira: I saw that. It's in a transient package in runtime/minimal-rootless. I'm patching the Dockerfile to pin a fixed package version and trigger a rebuild. ETA 2h.

elena: For the incident side: please create a short postmortem if that makes it into prod, but if we catch it in CI then just add a vuln-triage note. Also, can we add a pre-sign scan gate in the pipeline so signing fails on high CVE severity?

samir: Agreed on pre-sign gate. We can wire a vulnerability scan step (grype) that fails the job on severity >= high unless an exemption ticket exists. Exemptions must be recorded in the vuln tracker with owner + expiry.

arik: I'll open a short RFC in #eng-runtime describing the pipeline changes. For rollout plan:
- Day 0 (dev): enable SBOM+attest+sign on dev images, KMS dev key exists, RBAC applied.
- Day 2 (stage): enable on stage, export audit logs to staging SIEM sink, test rotation.
- Day 4 (prod canary): enable on 10% of base-image builds, monitor alerts and cosign verifies downstream.
- Day 7 (full prod): flip for all builds.

mira: Sounds good. Add a rollback clause: if cosign verification fails downstream or our downstream registries reject signatures, revert by disabling signing and redeploying an unsigned manifest.

elena: +1 on rollback. Also: ensure our runtime image loader tolerates signed manifests (we'll need to inform ops teams that we now serve cosign signatures in the registry).

auditor-bot: NOTE: Compliance check required: retention of SBOMs and attestations for 2 years. Automation required to copy artifacts to cold storage after 90 days.

samir: I'll add lifecycle rule for sbom/ and cosign/ prefixes to move to nearline/cold after 90 days and retention 2y.

arik: OK team — action items:
- samir: terraform RBAC + KMS keys per env + lifecycle rules.
- mira: add pre-sign vulnerability gate and patch runtime/minimal-rootless now.
- elena: set SIEM sink and retention requirements, audit playbook update.
- me (arik): rollout RFC and canary schedule.

mira: I'll push the patch now and ping here when green.

samir: starting terraform plan for dev keys.

elena: FYI I'll loop in legal on the 2y retention for SBOMs.

arik: Thanks — try to keep signing disabled for prod until we confirm the CVE is cleared and scans are green. :thumbsup:

mira: Patch merged, dev build triggered. devops-bot: build runtime/minimal-rootless:build-2026-03-15 started

devops-bot: build runtime/minimal-rootless:build-2026-03-15 succeeded 
  artifacts: gcr.io/redwood-inference/runtime/minimal-rootless:2026-03-15
  sbom: sbom/runtime-minimal-rootless-2026-03-15.spdx.json
  cosign_sig: cosign/runtime-minimal-rootless-2026-03-15.sig

arik: Great — I'll hold the prod flip until stage signals green and we validate attestations + audit pipeline. Thanks everyone.
